scientific_question: After the observable global potential s_t and current evidence x_t are known, does the functional fast-weight state alpha elementwise-multiplied by P_t contain a replicated low-dimensional readout that is sufficient for the next global update and remote relation-LOO reassembly?
current_theory: The local L_T computation is exactly compressed by an edge accumulator and fixed Gram kernel. The global field is nearly additive, but s_t is not a closed learning state. Scalar history restores remote amount with wrong allocation, whereas item history improves allocation error while losing amount. P_t may retain interacting internal state controlling both update strength and redistribution.
primary_hypothesis: Within each independently trained backbone, a supervised low-rank projection of the part of alpha elementwise-multiplied by P_t not linearly predictable from s_t captures at least 95 percent of the held-out one-step benefit of the full functional-P oracle and preserves both the magnitude and allocation of remote relation-LOO effects.
claim_boundary: This is a read-only functional sufficiency upper-bound audit. A positive result identifies a backbone-specific predictive readout and a replicated dimensional requirement, not aligned coordinates, an autonomous state update, a unique reduced algorithm, a human mechanism, or a biological variable. Human experiment design and Liu behavioral fitting are outside this stage.
forbidden_targets: Liu participant data, human accuracy, symbolic-distance slope, serial-position profile, posterior comparator, or any human-derived target
true order, query labels, response labels, reward, relation identity, selected H>A or F>A flags, or local L_T values during fitting
checkpoint retraining, P_t intervention, output-readout fitting, behavior calibration, or autonomous latent dynamics fitting
dimension, ridge, split, threshold, functionalization, residualization, or estimator changes after execution

trajectory_contract.replay: Recreate the exact v1 generic episodes, schedules, natural prefixes, and lexicographically selected relation-LOO branches with the original per-seed RNG and four batches of 32 episodes.
trajectory_contract.identity_gate: Before any P_t fit or metric is interpreted, natural evidence, every natural s_t and pair field, and terminal LOO s_T and pair field must match the valid frozen v1 NPZ slices to maximum absolute error at most 1e-6.
trajectory_contract.functional_state: The sole primary fast-weight state is vec(alpha elementwise-multiplied by P_t) before the current support trial. No alternative P normalization or raw-P selection is admissible.
trajectory_contract.loo_prefixes: In addition to the v1 terminal LOO identity target, retain functional P_t and s_t at every LOO prefix so the frozen predictor can be evaluated on the complete omitted branch.
trajectory_contract.storage: Raw functional-P trajectories are held only in memory and are not a new scientific artifact. Save the fitted residualization and supervised projection coefficients plus aggregate metrics, not participant or human data.

within_backbone_split.training: The first three exact v1 extraction batches, episode indices 0 through 95, are training episodes.
within_backbone_split.held_out: The fourth exact v1 extraction batch, episode indices 96 through 127, is the only evaluation set.
within_backbone_split.scope: Fit and evaluate separately inside each backbone. Never pool fast-weight entries, transitions, episodes, coefficients, or projection coordinates across seeds.

estimators.target: y_t=s_(t+1)-s_t, represented in raw centered eight-item potential coordinates.
estimators.baseline: Fit y_t from f_t=[s_t,x_t] by no-intercept ridge regression on natural training transitions only.
estimators.potential_residualization: Fit vec(alpha elementwise-multiplied by P_t)=s_t C+r_t by no-intercept ridge regression on natural training transitions only; use the same C on held-out natural and LOO states.
estimators.full_P_oracle: Fit the baseline residual y_t-f_t B_0 from r_t with full dual ridge regression on natural training transitions only. The prediction is f_t B_0+r_t B_P.
estimators.supervised_rank_reduction: Take right singular output directions V of the full oracle's fitted training contribution r_t B_P. For rank k, Q_k=B_P V_k, z_t=r_t Q_k, and the prediction is f_t B_0+z_t V_k^T. Q_k is supervised and backbone-specific.
estimators.rank_reason: Centered eight-item updates have at most seven linearly independent output directions. Ranks 8, 16, and 32 would add arbitrary zero-information directions under this frozen linear reduced-rank audit.
estimators.ridge: For every design matrix X, use lambda_abs=1e-4 times trace(X^T X) divided by its feature count; do not standardize entries, tune lambda, add an intercept, restart, or select a normalization.
estimators.precision: Extract alpha elementwise-multiplied by P_t in checkpoint float32, fit the large full-P system on GPU in float32, and compute reported errors and summaries in float64.

sufficiency_estimands.one_step: On held-out natural transitions report E0, Efull, and Ek as mean squared potential-update errors. Define eta_k=(E0-Ek)/(E0-Efull) without clipping, only when Efull<E0. Bootstrap paired episode error differences within each backbone.
sufficiency_estimands.remote_reassembly: Apply the same B0, C, BP, V, and Qk without refitting to every held-out natural and LOO prefix. Starting from the observed branch s_0, cumulatively sum teacher-forced predicted updates. Compare natural-minus-LOO terminal additive pair fields with the full neural terminal pair-field influence, reporting all-pair correlation plus disjoint-pair magnitude ratio and MSE.
sufficiency_estimands.full_oracle_prerequisite: Within each backbone the full-P oracle must reduce held-out one-step MSE by at least 10 percent versus baseline with the paired 95 percent episode interval below zero, and must have remote correlation at least 0.70, remote magnitude ratio in [0.50,1.50], and remote MSE below baseline.
sufficiency_estimands.rank_sufficiency: A rank k is sufficient within one backbone only if eta_k is at least 0.95, its paired one-step improvement interval versus baseline lies below zero, remote correlation is at least 0.70, remote magnitude ratio lies in [0.50,1.50], remote MSE is below baseline, and remote MSE is at most 1.10 times full-oracle remote MSE.
sufficiency_estimands.k_min: Report the smallest registered k satisfying every rank-sufficiency condition. Do not select separate ranks for one-step and remote metrics.

bootstrap.unit: held-out generic episode within backbone; networks are never pooled

runtime.device: A visible GPU is mandatory for frozen neural replay and large full-P regression.
runtime.cpu_threads: PyTorch intra-op and inter-op threads are each fixed to one.
runtime.compile: Use the exact frozen v1 replay path without torch.compile because numerical identity to the v1 trajectory artifact is an integrity gate; this audit does not retrain the network.

outcome_tree.replicated_low_dimensional_functional_P_: All integrity and full-oracle prerequisites pass independently, and k_min is at most 4 in all three backbones. Proceed to a separately frozen autonomous latent-dynamics closure test without aligning coordinates.
outcome_tree.replicated_full_output_rank_functional_P: All integrity and full-oracle prerequisites pass independently and every backbone has a sufficient k_min, but at least one requires k=7. Preserve functional-P sufficiency but do not call the requirement extremely low-dimensional; next closure must retain the replicated required rank.
outcome_tree.one_step_functional_signal_without_remot: Every full-P oracle has a registered one-step benefit but at least one full oracle or every low-rank readout fails remote sufficiency. Preserve predictive P information but do not use it to design an autonomous reduced state; localize why causal allocation is absent.
outcome_tree.functional_P_linear_audit_insufficient: Integrity passes but the full-P one-step prerequisite fails in any backbone. The registered linear supervised readout does not establish that residual functional P supplies the missing state; do not feature-engineer another P normalization after inspection.
outcome_tree.noninterpretable: Any source, artifact, replay identity, split, shape, finite-value, GPU, thread, or algebraic rank-reconstruction gate fails. Repair provenance or implementation under a separately recorded lock before interpretation.

stop_rules: Do not inspect held-out episode metrics before the implementation source lock is committed and pushed.
Do not add PCA, raw P_t, normalized P_t, absolute-alpha P_t, hidden state, eligibility, nonlinear kernels, alternate ranks, ridge selection, or seed pooling after execution.
Do not infer autonomous closure from a sufficient readout. A positive audit only licenses a separately frozen z_(t+1)=G(z_t,s_t,x_t) test.
If full-P prediction improves but remote reassembly fails, do not call z_t the missing global state; preserve the one-step link and localize the remote discrepancy.
If the audit fails, retain the exact local algorithm and the high-dimensional-interacting-state to low-dimensional-output theory rather than forcing further compression.
